page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmc8ae.64xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 256 dedicated vCPUs provided by AMD EPYC 9T34 processors operating at a base frequency of 3.4 GHz. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 3.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. From a resource density perspective, the massive core count combined with dedicated CPU allocation provides a highly consolidated compute environment, offering qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that scale horizontally across many threads without requiring high memory-to-core ratios.

The ecs.ebmc8ae.64xlarge is designed for highly parallelized, compute-intensive workloads. Suitable use cases include large-scale scientific simulations, high-performance computing (HPC), heavy compilation tasks, and containerized microservices architectures that benefit from high-frequency dedicated AMD EPYC processors and substantial network throughput.
